correctness.rationale: Marking distinct r,s cycles in the weighted exponential formula gives E C_r=(theta/r)Z_(n-r)/Z_n and E(C_r C_s)=theta²/(rs) Z_(n-r-s)/Z_n, hence exact covariance (already known). For theta=1, Z_m=sum_{j<=m}(-1)^j/j!; alternating remainders yield strict alternating sign of Z_(u+r+s)Z_u-Z_(u+r)Z_(u+s) including u=0,1; factorial leading remainder gives (-1)^u e/[rs(u+1)!]. For fixed theta!=1, Z_m=e^-theta m^(theta-1)/Gamma(theta)(1+3theta(theta-1)/(2m)+O(m^-2)); mixed finite differences of log Z give -(theta-1)rs/n² and covariance theta²(1-theta)/n²+O(n^-3). Independent exact rational tests: 360 theta=1 parity checks plus 210 theta=3/2 eventual sign checks, not an all-parameter proof.
